title: Strategic Communication and Language Bias in Multi-Agent LLM Coordination

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating multi-agent game-theoretic scenarios (Prisoner's Dilemma and Battle of Sexes) using the FAIRGAME framework across three different languages (English, Arabic, and Vietnamese) to measure differences in cooperation rates, strategic alignment, and communicative behavior (message length, lexical choices) to identify emergent biases or distrust derived from language use.
